ja: 触 れ て 感 じ る 生 命 の 記 憶 ―
恐 竜 骨 格 プ ラ モ デ ル
恐竜骨格をプラモデル化。恐竜骨格プラモデル「トリケラトプス」が登場。
鉱物を多く含む新素材「ＬＩＭＥＸ」を採用。頭から尻尾までを約160mmのこだわりの造形で再現。
ＬＩＭＥＸとは・・・
＜地球環境に優しい新素材＞
日本で生まれた新たな成形材料。
主原料が石灰石を５０％以上含み、従来の石油由来樹脂の使用を大きく削減。
ＣＯ２排出削減にも貢献できる材料として、持続可能な資源循環を目指しています。
●　新素材「ＬＩＭＥＸ」を採用することで化石という存在にリアリティを宿し、太古に躍動した命の息吹を感じられるプラモデルに
［触感］
石膏のような乾いた手触り
［質感］
マットな表面が柔らかな光沢を帯びる
［重量］
従来のプラスチックよりも石灰石の比重が多く、重さを感じる
●　関節部分はパーツが分割されているため、イメージに合わせた姿勢で展示が可能
●　植物をすり潰す植物食恐竜の独特な歯の形状を再現。こだわりの造形で再現

en: Memories of life that you can touch and feel.
dinosaur skeleton plastic model
Plastic model of dinosaur skeleton. Introducing the dinosaur skeleton plastic model "Triceratops".
Adopts a new material "LIMEX" containing a lot of minerals. The figure is carefully sculpted with a length of approximately 160mm from head to tail.
What is LIMEX?
<New material that is friendly to the global environment>
A new molding material created from a book.
The main raw material contains over 50% limestone, greatly reducing the use of conventional petroleum-derived resins.
We aim for sustainable resource circulation as a material that can also contribute to reducing CO2 emissions.
● By using the new material "LIMEX", the existence of fossils is imbued with reality, creating a plastic model that allows you to feel the breath of life that flourished in ancient times.
[Tactile sensation]
Dry texture like plaster
[Texture]
Matte surface has a soft luster
[weight]
The specific gravity of limestone is higher than that of conventional plastics, making it feel heavier.
● The joints are divided into parts, so you can display it in a posture that matches your image.
● Reproduces the unique tooth shape of plant-eating dinosaurs that grind plants. Reproduced with special modeling
Set contents)
・Dinosaur skeleton plastic model Triceratops x 1
*Due to the characteristics of the material, parts may come off the Runner during shipping.
There are no quality problems, so you can use it for assembly.
*It may be sold at some facilities/events in the future.
*LIMEX is an inorganic filler-dispersed composite material that contains more than 50% inorganic substances such as calcium carbonate.
*Runner is labeled as "PS", but the material of the product is a composite material made of limestone (calcium carbonate) as the main raw material combined with PS.
